directive.quote: Port the importers and decoders one to one into trillion-workshop tools/conversations/ (keep names, tests, moved-from.json, a tool row per action). Move code, never rewrite.

old_copy.deleted_with: already gone from Trillion-X/trillion main (absent at 9bed45cbd8) when the Worker retired; the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire keeps the history

preserve: importConversation keeps one chat through the message owner's record(), a hundred messages a batch, each with its source_ref, so a repeat adds nothing twice
keepConversationRow writes only facts read from the chat (title, app, conversation, started, last, messages, models), so labels, people, pursuits and follow-ups set by the person stay on a re-import
attachmentFinder and the space branch unchanged; a file that cannot be found is reported, never an error
exportedConversations reads a JSON export or the conversations*.json of an export zip through the one archive reader
allowed_deltas: the Worker's store becomes the records door: eeaf is stagedRecords(door).eeaf and commit its commit (reads first, then the step's writes in door-sized batches); lists are listsOverDoor(door)
importChatExport (the Worker reading an export from hosted files in pages) becomes the resumable run over files on this computer, with a cursor row per file and per source
writes and reads are sent again after a growing wait on 503, timeouts and unknown outcomes, with the same request key
local AI apps' sessions are read by the moved harness rules (harness/record-every-message.mjs rowsFrom and messagesOf)
banned_substitutions: a new message store or identity instead of the moved message owner
a source location written into the code
an inference model reading or rewriting the conversations

test_refs: tools/conversations/test/import-conversations.test.mjs each source keeps one row per conversation and its messages, and a second run adds nothing
tools/conversations/test/import-conversations.test.mjs a door that answers 503 midway stops the run where it was kept, and a resume finishes with nothing kept twice
tools/conversations/test/chat-history-identity.test.mjs trusted history preserves its complete conversation identity, files and timestamps without opening work
tools/conversations/test/chat-export-zip.test.mjs a zip export gives the conversations of every conversations*.json
